capabilities: search external APIs by title or ID
import search results as notes with template tags
download poster images to a chosen folder
bulk import preexisting media notes by folder
remap or remove generated metadata fields
disambiguation: Not a local media catalog; it fetches metadata from external APIs to create new notes.
extras: Some APIs work without keys while others need a free key or account; Moby Games support was removed (no longer free) and Giant Bomb support was temporarily removed because its API is non-functional.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up media metadata in external databases, so users must create movie, game, or book notes by hand.

relations.evidence: Tenrai is an API that uses My Anime List and offers metadata for anime.

requires.name: OMDb, TMDB, Comic Vine, Boardgame Geek

summary: Queries multiple external media APIs (movies, series, anime, games, books, comics, music, wiki articles) and imports the metadata as notes into the vault.
